name: Georgia
notes: Georgia supports digital ID in Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet.

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone (iOS 15.4 or later required).
Tap the + button and choose 'Driver's License or State ID'.
Select Georgia from the state list.
Scan the front and back of your Georgia driver's license or ID card.
Complete the face and motion scan to verify your identity.
Your request is sent to the Georgia DDS. You'll receive a notification once approved — usually within a few minutes.

wallets.name: Google Wallet
steps: Open Google Wallet on your Android device.
Tap + and select 'ID documents', then 'Driver's license or state ID'.
Scan the front and back of your Georgia driver's license or ID.
Complete the selfie step to verify your identity.
Georgia DDS will process and approve your digital ID within a few minutes.

wallets.name: Samsung Wallet
steps: Open Samsung Wallet on your Samsung device.
Scan the front and back of your Georgia driver's license or ID.
Georgia DDS will verify and approve your digital ID.
